arguments.subject: Re: why am I being logged out every time I switch machines?
arguments.body:
Hi Maya,

Thank you for reaching out, and I’m sorry for the frustration and disruption this has caused. I want to give you a clear, direct answer about what’s happening:

As of now, Cursor does not intentionally sign users out of previous devices when they sign in on a new one with the same Google SSO account. Your sign-in session should remain active across devices unless you manually sign out or there is an active security policy change. If you are being signed out each time you move between machines, this is not expected behavior and does not reflect any new policy or intended update.

The change you describe—being logged out automatically from one device after signing in on another—suggests there may be a bug affecting multi-device SSO sessions. We do not have documentation indicating this as intended, and it is not related to payment or device-binding policies (those only affect billing actions, not sign-in sessions).

For urgent resolution, we recommend:
• Make sure you are allowing cookies for `accounts.google.com` and `cursor.com` on all browsers and devices.
• Try signing in using a private/incognito window in case there’s an extension or cached session interfering.

Since this directly affects your workflow and we cannot resolve it through published steps, I am escalating your ticket immediately to our human support team for in-depth investigation. You will hear from a human support engineer as soon as possible.

Thank you for your patience, and again, I apologize for the disruption. We value your long-term support and will prioritize getting this fixed.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: Invoice PDF won't download
arguments.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks for letting us know you're having trouble downloading your March invoice. If clicking the download button just spins and eventually times out, the problem is most likely a temporary glitch with cached browser data or a server-side stall.

Here are the recommended steps to resolve this:

1. Try opening your invoice in a private or incognito browser window, then click Download. This bypasses any cached data or problematic extensions.
2. Make sure pop-ups and downloads are allowed for `billing.cursor.com` in your browser settings.
3. If the issue persists across browsers, try clearing your browser cache and cookies for `cursor.com`.
4. If none of this works, let us know and we’ll escalate to a human engineer for direct assistance.

Your patience is appreciated! Please reply if the issue continues, and we'll get you what you need by the end of the week.

Best,
Lyra Support Bot

arguments.subject: Re: Feature request: keyboard shortcut for inline edit
arguments.body:
Hi Riya,

Thank you for your suggestion and for checking if there’s already a keyboard shortcut for triggering inline edit. Currently, activating inline edits requires using a mouse or trackpad (cmd-K followed by a click) — there isn’t a dedicated keyboard-only shortcut at this time.

Your request is valuable and I’ve logged it as a feature request with our product team. We’re always working to improve accessibility and ergonomics, so your feedback helps shape our roadmap.

If a shortcut is introduced in a future update, we’ll announce it in the release notes and update the Help Center accordingly.

Thanks again for your input!

Best,
Lyra Support Bot
